programme: Split-Zero cohomology: original theta quotient and arithmetic observation

results.why: Computes the full Weil form from the complete xi function, proves explicit cubic positivity including the unknown high-zero tail, and certifies five original-pole matrices through degree eight.
results.status: finite positivity proved; unrestricted degree criterion not evaluated

results.why: Calculates the actual arithmetic recurrence defect against the Lie action, proves it cannot vanish identically for any real centre, and gives the exact finite induced selfadjoint operator.
results.status: complete nonvanishing and finite receiver; no uniform growing-degree estimate

results.why: Carries finite-prime transfers into the original theta quotient and computes the complex currents of both mixed and separately minimizing lifts, including the degree-raising boundary correction.
results.status: exact source and quotient maps; native asymptotic not evaluated

results.why: Relates the literal prolate Hermite seed to the original theta source with every scalar factor, the omitted Gaussian lattice tail, endpoint tails and higher derivatives of repeated-zero quotient jets.
results.status: complete strip and fixed-packet estimate; no minimum-Weil-vector approximation or spectral convergence claim
